description: Get the current constituent list of a major US or Canadian stock index: S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600, Nasdaq-100, Russell 1000, Russell 2000, the Dow Jones Industrial Average, the S&P/TSX 60, S&P/TSX Composite, S&P/TSX Venture Composite and the S&P/TSX capped sector indexes. Each row carries the company's rank by weight, its ticker, and its share of the index. A US list is a full-replication tracking fund's own disclosed holdings, taken from an SEC Form N-PORT filing or from the holdings file the fund publishes daily; a Canadian list is the constituent list TMX Money publishes under the index's symbol; the answer names which source and which date it came from. A partial filing is never served as a shrunken index. Rows not matched to a tracked company keep the name the source reported instead of being dropped. Use GetIndexChanges for what has joined or left, and GetIndexForecast for who the published rules point to next.

index.description: Index name or slug, for example "S&P 500", "sp-500", "nasdaq-100", "Russell 2000" or "S&P/TSX 60".

maxResults.description: Maximum constituents to return, heaviest first (default 100, max 500).

offset.description: Rows to skip before returning, for paging through a full list (default 0).

name: GetIndexComposition
title: Index Constituents
